name: concord
description: Hub Privado Gamer de Voz, Tela e Chat para Amigos

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run prisma:push --prefix server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
